# grilling — Stress-testing an idea

## 1. Name and localization

- **English name:** `grilling`
- **Translation:** Stress-testing an idea.
- **Source skill:** [`SKILL.md`](https://github.com/PVMalove/agent-harness-next/blob/master/skills/vendor/mattpocock/productivity/grilling/SKILL.md)

## 2. Russian description

Breaks an idea, a plan, or a decision down with questions and concrete scenarios until verifiable boundaries appear.

## 3. Application

The source `SKILL.md` defines the exact order of steps, the entry conditions, and the limits. This page is a Russian pointer to the pinned upstream version.

In `engineering-suite`, a [first-party override](../grilling.md) is used. With project memory enabled, the interactive
session looks for past decisions and checks the status and hash of the pointer. It adds paths to the Live Artifact
only with the user's consent (opt-in).
The vendor snapshot stays unchanged.
